items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: the best drummers that I remember they had here was Lloyd Cottrell

ctx.x: His brother, Bebe Matthews, one of the best drummers you had here. You know, that was a trumpet. With the exception of, uh, Oh, no. Lloyd Cottrell.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: He was around the Third War, too... Then we had Cook Shop Son. He was another drummer.

ctx.x: Who was the drummer Two Bits? Do you remember what his name was?

Yeah, Lloyd Two Bits. Yeah, he was around the Third War, too. I forgot to mention his name. What was his drummer? He was a pretty good little drummer. I never did know his right name. All I know was Two Bits because I was small then, you know. He had a pretty good edge on him then. But he was a pretty good little drummer, too. Then we had Cook Shop Son. He was another drummer.
